Example Configurations

Examples only — every building is custom

The dimensions below are illustrative starting points, not fixed product sizes. Tell us your exact space requirements and we'll design accordingly.

i These are example configurations to help you visualize scale. Actual buildings are built to your exact specified dimensions — there is no fixed size catalogue for prefab buildings.

Construction Specifications

What's included in every build

ComponentSpecification
Frame StructureGalvanised light steel frame — engineered for local wind/seismic loads
Wall InsulationEPS or rock wool sandwich panels — 50mm to 150mm thickness options
RoofingInsulated roof panels with optional skylights and rainwater collection
FlooringRaised steel/concrete composite floor — vinyl, epoxy, or tile finish options
ElectricalFull wiring, distribution board, LED lighting, outlets — to local code
PlumbingWater supply, drainage, and washroom fit-out available on request
Windows & DoorsDouble-glazed windows, insulated doors, optional roller shutters
Climate ControlSplit AC / HVAC sized to building volume and use case
Size RangeAny size per demand — no minimum, no fixed maximum
Delivery FormatFlat-pack modular panels or fully pre-assembled modules (project-dependent)
Process

From dimensions to delivery

01
Share Your Dimensions
Tell us your required size, use case, and site location. We confirm feasibility within 48 hours.
02
Design & Quote
We provide a layout drawing, materials specification, and detailed quotation for your approval.
03
Manufacture & Ship
Components are manufactured at our factory and shipped via sea or land freight to your site location.
04
Assemble & Handover
On-site assembly by our team or guided remote installation. Typical assembly time: 5–15 days depending on size.
